decision.next_step: Keep the same-ms guard, then target remaining rigid-grid/starvation failures with timing-continuity or conditioned event-budget objectives.
decision.reason: same-ms event guard removed max-token duplicate loops without dead ends

experiment: Target grammar v3 same-ms event guard
interpretation: This is TEST_NEXT for grammar legality hardening, not replacement approval. The guard fixes a real online-generation legality gap, but remaining failures are timing continuity, rigid grids, and event-count calibration.
key_findings: The same-ms event guard removed the four max-token duplicate-event loops from the event-budget checkpoint.
Max-token cases improved from pre-guard 4 to 0.
Max duplicate/non-increasing spacing ratio improved from 0.910 to 0.000.
The full 32-case gate is legal after the guard, but starvation remains high at 22 cases.
Rigid cases remain 9 and median event ratio remains below baseline at 0.585.
